Item 1. Business

We operate retail stores across several regions and sell consumer electronics, appliances and related services to individual and business customers. Our stores carry a curated assortment of products from major manufacturers alongside our own private-label lines, supported by a logistics network that lets us restock high-turnover items multiple times per week in most of our larger markets. We also operate an online storefront that has grown to account for a meaningful share of total sales in recent years, particularly in categories where home delivery is preferred over an in-store purchase.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

None.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis

Comparable sales declined modestly year over year across our reporting segments, driven primarily by softer discretionary spending in the appliance category, partially offset by resilient demand for everyday consumer electronics. Gross margin held roughly flat as favorable input costs offset continued investment in store remodels and our online fulfillment network, and we expect comparable sales trends to stabilize as prior-year promotional activity laps out of the comparison base over the next two fiscal quarters.
